title: matrix_diag_mul_stat~
description: `matrix_diag_mul_stat~` multiplies an n-dimensional input signal vector by a dynamic diagonal n×n signal matrix, producing an n-dimensional output signal vector without interpolation. Its creation argument sets n (the number of signal inlets and outlets), and the diagonal can be set with a `diag` message containing n floats or an `element` message containing a 1-based diagonal index and value.
